clue.text: Confederacy protects port

parts.note: the Confederacy was the breakaway South in the American Civil War
shields is a verb meaning protects

explanation.surface: A league of states keeps a harbour safe from attack.
explanation.walkthrough: The Confederacy was the group of Southern states in the American Civil War, so it is the South. SOUTH SHIELDS is a port town in north-east England at the mouth of the Tyne.
explanation.definitionFit: A coastal town with a harbour on the Tyne estuary, so a seaport.

clue.text: Fly over deliverer

definitions.meaning: an angler's fishing fly that revolves in the water
in cricket an over is six balls delivered by a bowler; a slow bowler who turns the ball is so called

explanation.surface: An insect travels above a postman.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, an over is a set of six deliveries by one bowler; a spin bowler is called this.
explanation.definitionFit: A revolving fishing lure, and a slow cricket bowler who makes the ball turn.

clue.text: Opened and destroyed

definitions.meaning: unfastened, as a knot or button
ruined, as in someone brought down

explanation.surface: Something was unfastened and wrecked.
explanation.definitionFit: Past tense of unfasten, and also of ruin or bring to downfall.

clue.text: Concorde is so extravagant

definitions.meaning: the supersonic airliner cruised at great altitude

explanation.surface: The supersonic airliner is a lavish indulgence.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally soared at altitude; figuratively grandiose, pretentious language.

clue.text: Deceive House over a vote

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits above the rest

parts.note: a cross on a ballot paper marks a vote

explanation.surface: Misleading Parliament about a ballot.
explanation.definitionFit: To trick by a hoax is to deceive.

clue.text: Part of arch that has more functions

parts.note: extra means more or additional
dos are parties or functions

explanation.surface: A section of an arch with extra roles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'do' is British informal for a party, so 'functions' gives DOS.
explanation.definitionFit: The extrados is the upper or outer curve of an arch.

clue.text: It's hot in food store in Asian city

indicators.note: the first piece goes inside the second

parts.note: a deli is a delicatessen shop
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: It is sweltering inside a delicatessen in an Asian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Delhi is a major city in northern India.

clue.text: Close a humble dwelling

parts.note: to bung is to stop up or close a hole
low means lowly or humble

explanation.surface: Shutting a modest home.
explanation.definitionFit: A bungalow is a one-storey house, a type of home.

clue.text: Offspring of woman is brought in, an innocent child

indicators.note: one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: a cub is the young of an animal
her is the possessive of a woman

explanation.surface: A woman's child is admitted, a blameless infant.
explanation.definitionFit: A cherub is a chubby angelic infant, hence a sweet guileless youngster.

clue.text: Stirred up new gin and it mixture

indicators.note: a mixture blends things together, so these letters are to be jumbled into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A barman stirs up a cocktail of fresh gin and Italian vermouth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stirred up' looks like a bartender's instruction but is the definition, meaning roused to anger. 'gin and it' is a gin and Italian vermouth cocktail.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone stirred up is angered and resentful at perceived unfairness.

clue.text: It controls water level, we hear, in lake

indicators.note: signals that the word is said aloud and a word of the same sound is entered

parts.note: a canal lock raises or lowers the water level for boats

explanation.surface: A device for regulating water is found in a lake.
explanation.walkthrough: LOUGH, the Irish word for a lake, is pronounced like 'lock'.
explanation.definitionFit: In Ireland a lough is a lake or sea inlet, the counterpart of a Scottish loch.

clue.text: Fall asleep like don, perhaps?

definitions.meaning: to drop into sleep while sitting
the word don is the word nod set off, out of its usual order, read cryptically as an instruction

explanation.surface: A university lecturer dozing off, as dons are said to do.
explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads the answer cryptically: the letters of NOD put 'off', i.e. turned around, give DON, with the question mark flagging the trick. The dozing academic of the surface is misdirection.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop into sleep, especially unintentionally while sitting, is a common idiom for dozing.

clue.text: Invent a complaint to make mother hang around

parts.note: ma is an informal word for mother
to linger is to hang around

explanation.surface: Someone fakes an illness so their mother has to wait about.
explanation.definitionFit: To feign illness to avoid work is to pretend to have an ailment.

clue.text: Publish that old American author

parts.note: a newspaper runs a story when it publishes it
yon is an archaic word for that

explanation.surface: An editor decides to print the work of a long-gone American writer.
explanation.walkthrough: Damon Runyon wrote stories of Broadway gamblers and gangsters, the basis of Guys and Dolls.
explanation.definitionFit: Damon Runyon was a US short-story writer and journalist.

clue.text: Little bird getting settled in comfortably

definitions.meaning: a young bird not yet able to leave the nest

explanation.surface: A small bird is getting cosy.
explanation.definitionFit: A chick still in its nest; also the present participle of snuggle down.

clue.text: Driver, perhaps, used by one of its members

definitions.text: Driver, perhaps, used by one of its members

parts.words: Driver, perhaps, used by one of its members
parts.note: a driver is one kind of stick for hitting a golf ball, and such a stick is used by a member of the association named by the same phrase

explanation.surface: A chauffeur is employed by one of the members of some institution.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Driver' suggests a chauffeur, but it is the longest-hitting stick in golf. The answer names both the implement and the society whose members wield it.
explanation.definitionFit: A driver is an example of the implement; the same phrase names the society whose members play.

clue.text: Hang frame crookedly here in Ireland

indicators.note: something hung crookedly is askew, so these letters are set out of order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Hanging a picture frame askew in an Irish home.
explanation.walkthrough: FERMANAGH is a county in Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: Fermanagh is a county in Northern Ireland, a place on the island.

clue.text: National emblem made of paste?

definitions.meaning: the three-leafed clover symbol of Ireland
paste is imitation gem glass, so a fake stone, read as two words

explanation.surface: A national symbol fashioned from glue.
explanation.walkthrough: Paste is glass used for imitation jewels: SHAM ROCK is a fake stone.
explanation.definitionFit: The trefoil clover is Ireland's symbol; and a phony gem, read as two words.

clue.text: It could be arranged as tab she provided for drink

indicators.note: arranging items changes their order, so these letters are to be put into a fresh sequence

parts.note: taken as written
in can mean included or provided, as in an all-in price or meals in

explanation.surface: A drink could be laid out as a bill a woman paid for.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be arranged' turns TABSHE plus IN into the answer. 'tab' looks like a bar bill, fitting the drinking surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Absinthe is a strong green aniseed-flavoured spirit flavoured with wormwood.

clue.text: Immediately take remedial action, having caught cold

indicators.note: the first piece holds the second inside it

parts.note: to atone is to make amends for a wrong
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Treat the problem straight away now you have a chill.
explanation.definitionFit: At once means without delay, straight away.

clue.text: Get more mature wife into class

indicators.note: one piece is placed inside the other, as the wife goes into the class

parts.note: a group is a class or category

explanation.surface: A wife joining an adult-education class to develop herself.
explanation.definitionFit: To grow up is to become adult and act with greater maturity.

clue.text: US city that's fireproof

definitions.meaning: the mythical bird reborn from its own ashes

explanation.surface: An American city that cannot burn.
explanation.definitionFit: Arizona's capital, and the legendary bird that rises unharmed from flames.

clue.text: State that's all right, in short

definitions.text: State that's all right, in short

parts.words: State that's all right, in short
parts.note: a US state whose postal abbreviation is the same two letters people write for all right

explanation.surface: Someone declares that things are fine, briefly.
explanation.walkthrough: The state's two-letter abbreviation is OK, which also means all right.
explanation.definitionFit: The US state abbreviated OK, in the south-central plains.

clue.text: Hard battle in board game

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
Alma was an 1854 battle of the Crimean War

explanation.surface: A tough fight over a board game.
explanation.definitionFit: Halma is a board game of jumping pieces, forerunner of Chinese chequers.

clue.text: Cowboy's mostly unsophisticated love

indicators.note: most but not all of the word is kept, so its final letter is dropped

parts.note: gauche means awkward and unsophisticated
love is nil in tennis, written as O

explanation.surface: A cowboy's romance is rather clumsy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts the last letter from GAUCHE, leaving GAUCH.
explanation.definitionFit: A gaucho is a South American cowboy of the pampas.

clue.text: Conservative member appears to be upwardly mobile

parts.note: a limb is a member of the body

explanation.surface: A Tory MP seems ambitious.
explanation.definitionFit: To climb is to ascend, socially or physically.

clue.text: Destroyed when cut

indicators.note: something destroyed is broken apart, so these letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: Ruined at the moment of being sliced.
explanation.definitionFit: Hewn is the past participle of hew, to chop with an axe.

clue.text: Central American alcohol found in Panama, for example

indicators.note: central signals that the letters come from the middle of the following words, across the gap

explanation.surface: A Latin American liquor turns up in Panama.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Central American' tempts a solver to think of a region; the letters sit in the middle of AmeriCAN ALcohol. 'found in' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: The Panama Canal is a famous example of an artificial waterway.

clue.text: Choice about time for exercise

indicators.note: the first word goes around the other, enclosing it

parts.note: an option is a choice
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Picking a time to work out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exercise' is a military exercise or campaign, not a workout.
explanation.definitionFit: A military exercise or campaign is an operation.

clue.text: Abandon TV for a toy

parts.note: to jack in is British slang for to give up or abandon
the box is informal for the television

explanation.surface: Giving up television in favour of playing with a plaything.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack in' is British slang for quit, and 'the box' British slang for the television set.
explanation.definitionFit: A box from which a figure on a spring pops up when the lid opens is a children's toy.
